move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note the increased volume and extended contract term in your proposal. However, your theoretical cost model does not reflect our specialized manufacturing processes. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. Which volume can you commit to?

For a volume of 23400 pcs per year, Lieferzeit 56 days, and a contract term of 36 months, our price of €31.70 per unit stands. For a volume of 23,400 units and a 36-month contract, our price is €31.70 per unit. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our specialized manufacturing processes and high utilization dictate these terms. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. For a volume of 23400 pcs per year and a contract term of 36 months, we can offer a price of €31.50 per unit. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

The arguments cite cost, the rising forecast and the price history; I left out the delivery record so the message stays cooperative while we ask for allocation.
